protocol.wire: JSON-RPC 2.0 with the jsonrpc header omitted, newline-delimited
protocol.surface: thread/start, thread/resume, turn/start, turn/interrupt; item/* and turn/completed notifications; execCommandApproval / applyPatchApproval server->client requests
protocol.notes: app-server names SandboxPolicy in camelCase (workspaceWrite/networkAccess); the core protocol uses kebab-case. Protocol tests in the codex repo are the wire-shape source of truth.
